relations.rationale: The report gives distinct dates and explicitly orders the two initial accesses. No action dependency is inferred.
The first-server narrative describes discovery after access through the same incident entry point.
The report places the file download after the discussion of discovery on the first server.
The following passage explicitly says network service enumeration occurred subsequently.
Credential guessing follows the reported service enumeration.
The incident overview describes the movement as originating from the compromised first server.
The overview orders the two destinations. This records reported order without treating the implementation wording as a verified topology.
The report explicitly places the first proxy execution after writing the binary.
The host checks follow the new access in the same activity passage.
The author places the modified proxy download next.
The report attributes the established connection to the modified software retrieval and subsequent use.

exclusions.rationale: The report links scanning and a later exploitation attempt but does not uniquely identify the first-server access as that attempt in the scanning passage.
The text describes discovery artifacts but does not tie a separately ordered action to the retained dated access.
The dated passage may overlap the earlier proxy activity. Retaining another distinct proxy run would risk double-counting.
The detailed wording uses host roles that are difficult to align with the overview. The graph carries only the reported ordering there.
